answer: Each challenge is bound to a future drand quicknet pulse: its round and domain-separated beacon output determine the task only after participants commit, so neither an operator nor a sybil swarm can precompute answers or farm valid responses offline. Verification checks the pulse and commitment, while rate limits or stake still govern identities; the beacon makes the voyage unpredictable, not magically sybil-proof, and prevents a hollow spiral of recycled proofs.
